# Jobman Global

> One Partner to Enter, Operate and Grow in India. Pan-India execution from Bengaluru HQ with dedicated global corridors.

Jobman Global helps international businesses enter, establish, and operate in India through Employer of Record (EOR), legal entity setup, GCC as a Service, and integrated operational support. Jobman Global also helps domestic Indian startups and established businesses build teams, manage payroll, handle statutory compliance, and scale operations through one accountable partner.

## Core Value Pillars

- **One Accountable Partner**: Single executive relationship managing your entire India operation with clear ownership boundaries and zero finger-pointing across functions.
- **Zero Fragmentation**: Eliminates managing 8 to 12 disconnected vendors (CAs, CSs, recruiters, payroll bureaus, lawyers, facilities vendors) through a single integrated delivery contract.
- **Compliance-First**: Uncompromising statutory governance across Companies Act, Indian Labor Codes, POSH, FEMA, GST, direct tax, and audit compliance.
- **India Delivery · Global Access**: Direct on-ground delivery across all 28 Indian States & UTs from Bengaluru HQ. Operating a **15-hour daily delivery cadence (08:00–23:00 IST)** providing 100% full-day synchronous overlap with Europe/UK and real-time morning sync with the Americas.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Market Entry & Advisory](https://jg.aryanservices.com/marketing-advisory.html): Part 1: Incorporation & Statutory Registrations (WOS, Pvt Ltd, LLP, Branch Office, FEMA, RBI approvals, GST, IEC). Part 2: HR, Legal & Compliance Advisory (POSH compliance framework, model standing orders, employment contracts, NDAs, IP assignment, ISMS / DPDP data protection).
- [Employer of Record (EOR) & Staffing](https://jg.aryanservices.com/staffing-eor.html): Hire and employ legally in India in 5–10 days without an entity. Under Indian labor jurisprudence, **Jobman Global acts as the Primary Employer** (assuming 100% statutory liability, payroll, and filings), while the client directs work as the **Principal Employer**. Offers 5 workforce models (Payroll-only, Full-service, Contract/Project, 3rd-Party Payroll, AOR) + Hybrid setup.
- [Talent Solutions](https://jg.aryanservices.com/talent-solutions.html): Hiring built on data, not guesswork. 6 flexible recruitment models (Managed, RPO, Executive Search, Training & Placement, Global Outbound, Mass Hiring) paired with integrated Background Verification (BGV).
- [Global Capability Centers (GCC as a Service)](https://jg.aryanservices.com/gcc.html): Turnkey captive and BOT center setup. Specializes in Tier-2/3 tech cities (Coimbatore, Kochi, Mysuru, Vizag, Jaipur, Indore, Raipur, Nagpur) delivering 30–45% operational cost savings and 12–15% low attrition. Features 4 delivery models: CoE / Micro-GCC (25–150 team), Offshore Development Center (ODC), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), and Captive / Fully-Owned Centers.
- [Global Growth Corridors](https://jg.aryanservices.com/global-india.html): International trade desks spanning EMEA (Basel Swiss anchor, TEPA $100B commitment, UAE CEPA), North America ($239.6B bilateral trade), APAC (India-Australia ECTA, ASEAN), and Growth Markets (43 LatAm nations, Mauritius DTAA routing). Features the interactive real-time 15-Hour Global Operating Time & Overlap Engine (#eu-live-clock).
- [Finance & Accounting](https://jg.aryanservices.com/finance-accounting.html): Multi-state payroll, bookkeeping, statutory audits, transfer pricing, and financial MIS.
- [Workplace & Operational Solutions](https://jg.aryanservices.com/workplace-solutions.html): Managed office infrastructure, enterprise IT hardware, group health insurance, and expat relocation/visas.
- [India Playbook & Knowledge Hub](https://jg.aryanservices.com/resources.html): EOR vs. Legal Entity 16-point decision matrix, 8–12 disconnected vendors replaced benchmark, Tier-2/3 city comparison, plain-English glossary, and CXO FAQs.
